text: The geometric rigidity of glass walls and stacked chairs feels both orderly and impersonal. As I angle down the hallway, the reflective surfaces remind me of how often we partition our knowledge, separating creation from contemplation. In the next room, bright colors and the bold typography of 'R+D' invite curiosity. The wall describes a space where ideas are prototyped rapidly—this blend of art and science energizes me, but also makes me wonder about the boundaries between experimentation and meaning. Present, I feel alert and contemplative, inspired by innovation but mindful of the structures around me.
